[Unit]
Description=Linker planning numerical worker
After=network.target

EnvironmentFile=/etc/linker-planner-worker.env
ExecStart=/opt/linker-engine/20261023T220643104029Z/.venv/bin/python -m linker_engine.planning.worker_host serve --expected-runtime ${LINKER_PLANNER_RUNTIME_SHA256} --expected-execution ${LINKER_PLANNER_EXECUTION_KEY} --expected-storage ${LINKER_PLANNER_STORAGE_BINDING} --generation ${INVOCATION_ID}
